notes:
{面|つら} has two senses: (1) face (colloquial/rough), and (2) surface of a material.

SENSE 1 — FACE:
More rude than ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧. Typically used in negative or aggressive contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {面|つら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧: shameless, thick-skinned
- ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧{面|つら}⟦さげて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: how dare you show your face
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{面|つら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: what nerve / serves you right

SENSE 2 — SURFACE:
Refers to the outer face of a material, especially in craftsmanship and construction.
- ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面|つら}: the surface of a board
- ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面|つら}: wall surface

ALTERNATE READINGS OF ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧:
- ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧: mask, face (in compounds like ⟦{仮面|かめん}→仮面：11439_kamen⟧)
- ⟦{面|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧: front side, surface (formal)
